name: tex-display
description: Renders display math ($$…$$, \[…\], equation/align/gather/multline) in Claude Code's terminal as images, with MathJax bundled: nothing to install

cellAspect.title: Terminal cell aspect
cellAspect.description: Terminal cell height ÷ width in pixels; set it with /tex-calibrate. When it's off, math is drawn slightly smaller than its cells, never distorted

scale.title: Math size
scale.description: Height of one TeX em in terminal rows (1 = one text line; the terminal font itself is about 0.8)
